scope: One fixed CPU-only continuation using frozen source rankings; no GPU or inference
comparison: Three-source equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion of existing SUPPORT_NLL Top2 lists
candidate_input_limit: Already frozen Top2 per source, at most six distinct grids per output
tie_break: RRF score descending, source support descending, Base24 rank ascending, canonical grid key ascending
tuning: No parameter sweep, no output-specific overrides, no Gold-based source choice
historical_comparator: Replay exact frozen S2 attempts, verify their ledgers and original Gold-derived 35-output scope. Only extend the score denominator to 89 if the other 54 outputs are confirmed candidate-oracle negatives for both Base sources; do not claim full-89 S2 attempt coverage.
scoring: Freeze new attempts before designated post-freeze scoring; task-cluster paired uncertainty; exposed development only
B_completion_audit: Count missing scoring inventory requests against verified complete cache units; logical dedup estimates are not exact token equivalence or newly available likelihoods
